0.0: Congratulations on your wedding! Now, have you given any thought to your #b#eCommitment Ceremony#n#k?\nA commitment ceremony is an event for couples in which their bond to each other becomes stronger.
0.1: Here at Wedding Village, we hold #b30 Day and 100 Day Commitment Ceremonies#k. After the ceremony, you'll receive a #b#ewedding ring upgrade#k#n and some #bother items for married couples#k to commemorate your commitment. See me when you've been married for 30 days, and I'll be more than happy to tell you what we need to begin your Commitment Ceremony.
0.2: Holding a #b30 Day Commitment Ceremony#k strengthens your wedding rings with the power of your commitment. Would you like to hold a 30 Day Commitment Ceremony?

yes.0: I hope to see you again soon.

no.0: Don't let the word commitment scare you. Just think of it as a small ceremony between you and the person you've committed to.

1.0: I've been expecting you. You've decided to hold a Commitment Ceremony? If so, I'll tell you how to proceed.
1.1: To conduct a 30 Day Commitment Ceremony, you'll need one #b#i5251016##t5251016##k. Purchase the ticket and bring it to #b#p9201013##k, and she will reserve the ceremony chapel for you.\nOnce the ceremony is done, you'll receive an #bupgraded Wedding Ring#k, #bLove Chair#k, and #b3 #t2030023#s#k that can be used to teleport to your spouse.

default.0: Please come see me when 30 days have passed from your wedding. I'll tell you how to conduct a Commitment Ceremony at that time. \r\nAlso remember that a Commitment Ceremony can't be conducted if you're in the middle of a divorce. It sounds like common sense, but you'd be surprised...
